Subject: Request for trial credits — evaluating embeddings+generation

I signed up for a self-serve account this morning (Sirius ML, ops@siriusml.io) and ran a couple of quick tests. The results look promising and we'd like to run a broader eval (embeddings + text generation) over the next two weeks.

Can we get some trial credits to accelerate our assessment? Quick context:

- Use-case: embeddings for semantic search + LLM assistant for internal docs
- Expected eval volume: ~3M tokens over 14 days
- Potential upsell: Dedicated capacity in Q2 if latency and cost targets hold

Signup id: SS-20270112-5821
HubSpot ref: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/contact/8732

I attached a one-page summary of our planned tests. Thanks — we can jump on a quick call if helpful.

Best,
Olivia Chen
Head of ML, Sirius ML

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for signing up and for the summary. I can escalate a short-term credit grant to get your team through the evaluation window. A few quick clarifying questions so I hand this to ops with the right ask:
- Do you need credits for both embeddings and generation? If so, split preference (e.g., 70% embeddings / 30% generation)?
- Any data residency or compliance needs (SOC2, EU-only)?
- Preferred contact for technical onboarding (Slack/Zoom)?

Im looping in Marissa (credits approvals) and Neha (onboarding) to triage. Will follow up shortly.

—Jordan
